# GitHub fixtures that TestParse expects to fail, one example ID per line.
# The list only gets shorter: remove an ID when its example passes.
#
# The first list was generated once, from an empty list, with:
#
#   go test ./internal/markdown -run '^TestParse$/^github$' 2>&1 |
#     sed -n 's/^ *--- FAIL: TestParse\/github\/github_example_\([0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' |
#     sort -n
